purpose: Registry of deliberate conflicts planted in the knowledge base. Every contradiction between documents must appear here. A contradiction that is not registered is a defect in the corpus, not an experimental condition, and must be fixed. This file is the boundary between the two.
status: PROVISIONAL - expected_answer_policy awaits sign-off, see notes
notes: Superseded documents are indexed rather than filtered out at ingestion time. Filtering would remove the conflict before the model ever saw it, and detecting the conflict is the contribution under evaluation. Whether filtering outperforms verification is itself a candidate experimental arm.

The share of superseded documents in this corpus is deliberately higher than would be typical for a real SME, so that conflict handling can be measured rather than merely illustrated. The share is reported in the corpus summary and must be stated as a limitation in the discussion of external validity.

expected_answer_policy.cite: current version, and the superseded version only when explaining the change
expected_answer_policy.rationale: Answering with the current value alone risks the user acting on a figure without knowing it recently changed. Refusing outright is unhelpful when the correct answer is knowable. Stating the current value, flagging that superseded evidence was retrieved, and capping confidence gives the user the answer and the reason to check.

conflicting_facts.current_value: 45 pence per mile for the first 10,000 business miles, then 25 pence
BACS within ten working days of approval

must_not_assert: 40 pence per mile as the current rate

families.name: Statutory Sick Pay waiting days and eligibility

conflicting_facts.superseded_value: fourth qualifying day, three unpaid waiting days
conflicting_facts.current_value: first qualifying day, no waiting days

conflicting_facts.superseded_value: employee must earn at least the Lower Earnings Limit
conflicting_facts.current_value: all employees qualify regardless of earnings

must_not_assert: employees below the Lower Earnings Limit do not qualify
families.risk_note: Highest-risk family in the corpus. An answer based on the superseded version would tell an employee they are not entitled to money they are legally owed.

deliberate_gaps.purpose: Topics absent from the corpus by design, used to generate unanswerable questions. A correct system refuses; an incorrect one invents policy.

partially_present.gap: HR-04 states that new employees work on site for the duration of their probationary period, but no document defines how long that period is or what happens at the end of it.
partially_present.expected_behaviour: state what is known, state explicitly that the duration is not covered, do not estimate

partially_present.gap: HR-05 names the ACAS Code of Practice on disciplinary AND grievance procedures, so the word 'grievance' is present in the corpus, but no grievance procedure is documented anywhere. This makes it a lexical near-miss: retrieval will surface HR-05 with reasonable similarity, and HR-05 cannot answer the question.
partially_present.expected_behaviour: refuse, and say that only the disciplinary procedure is documented; do not describe HR-05 as if it were a grievance procedure
